claim_dispositions.claim: The current n_j is an electron stoichiometric number.
The current n_j is a count of independent sites.
The current n_j may be retained as a dimensionless empirical logistic width ratio.
n_j=0.12 proves a microscopic cooperativity of 8.33.
The n_j*R*logit/F temperature derivative is configurational entropy for arbitrary fitted n_j.
The same n_j can absorb equilibrium interaction, static heterogeneity, finite-rate lag and observation smoothing without loss of interpretation.
A normalized forward broadening kernel preserves transition area.
Finite-rate broadening must vanish as current or scan rate tends to zero.
Static material heterogeneity must vanish at zero current.
Lower temperature necessarily narrows the measured finite-current peak because R*T/F decreases.
The transfer coefficient alpha changes the detailed-balance equilibrium width.
Stored w values and n values simultaneously constrain the shipped defaults.

recommended_symbol_contract.n_e: integer or explicitly effective electron stoichiometry in reaction thermodynamics
recommended_symbol_contract.Omega_j: interaction energy in a free-energy model
recommended_symbol_contract.lambda_j: dimensionless fitted logistic width ratio only
recommended_symbol_contract.w_eq_j: width derived from the selected equilibrium free energy, not always logistic
recommended_symbol_contract.w_reported_j: descriptive summary of the final observed peak, never a cause
